question: What is wa_mount_fury_west_west_ridge (West Ridge / Northwest Route) really, and what should its face/aspect say?
answer: It is the 1958 first-ascent line of West Fury, a west-side route, NOT the ridge from East Fury. The 1958 AAC account (Josendal, Muzzy, Sharpe, Spickard, Watson; mid-August 1958): from high camp on the upper Challenger Glacier / a col above Picket and Goodell Creeks, traverse steep heather, snowfields and a 400 ft descent to a glacier west of Fury; climb about 600 ft to a col and cross the bergschrund; climb one of two steep shallow chimneys (about 1,000 ft below the summit, piton-protected, around a chockstone) to the west ridge; broad ledge and rotten rock to a chimney system; short easy scramble to the summit; party benighted on descent. The article gives no grade. The traverse from East Fury (first done 1964) is a separate climb already held as wa_ridge_traverse_from_east_fury (5.4). Our row is internally mismatched: its overview describes the 1958 line, but face ('Connecting ridge crest between East Fury and West Fury summits'), beta (starts from East Peak via Southeast Glacier, three towers, 5.4), descent (reverse across the connecting ridge) and the Access Creek/Big Beaver approach are the East-to-West traverse, i.e. a duplicate of the traverse row. West Peak is the true high point (lidar 8,302.6 ft at 48.8117,-121.3229; East Fury older measurements 8,322-8,356 ft, so East was long thought higher; fewer than about 20 parties had stood on West by 2016). Aspect of the real line: west (the approach glacier lies west of the peak and the ridge is gained from the west). I found no guidebook grade; no source rates the 1958 line 5.4 (that figure belongs to the traverse and East Fury's East Ridge Direct). Mountain Project lists only Mongo Ridge on West Peak. Logged ascents on the peak are Mongo Ridge or the East-Fury traverse; none logs a west-side climb.
recommendation: Keep the row (distinct from the traverse and Mongo: different line, approach and first ascent) but fix it. face = west side glacier then steep chimneys to the west ridge; aspect = W. Rewrite beta, descent_text and approach to the west-side line, or blank them, rather than leave the East-traverse text (a duplicate of the traverse row). Do not state 5.4: set grade null (unrated, steep chimneys, low-5th by description) until a rating is found; discipline stays alpine (glacier, bergschrund, chimneys, pitons). The approach is a multi-day Northern Pickets trip via Picket Pass / Challenger Glacier or the Goodell Creek side, not Big Beaver; do not attach Big Beaver/Luna Camp waypoints or any track (none recorded). Season July-August.

proposed.face: West side: glacier west of the peak, then steep chimneys to the west ridge
proposed.overview_hint: The original line to West Fury: cross the glacier on the west side, pass the bergschrund, climb steep chimneys to the west ridge and finish with an easy scramble. Remote and committing; the descent is slow.
